claim: CSP (categorie socio-professionnelle), employment status, and full-time/part-time variables are published by INSEE at IRIS granularity (~2,000 inhabitants per zone), derived from the population census, structurally separate from the Filosofi-based gridded ('carreaux') products.
stance_target: Hypothesis that CSP data is only available at IRIS level (~2000 inhabitants), not at the 200m Filosofi grid
scope_conditions: INSEE Base infracommunale IRIS Activite des residents, 2020 vintage, France (Mayotte excluded from main file)
quoted_support: La base infracommunale «Activite des residents» fournit des donnees sur les caracteristiques des actifs (sexe, age, categorie socio-professionnelle), des salaries et non-salaries (sexe et age).

claim: A parallel INSEE IRIS-level database, 'Diplomes - Formation', separately publishes education/diploma-level variables (CEP, BEPC/brevet, CAP/BEP, baccalaureat, Bac+2, Bac+3/4), confirming that diploma-level data, like CSP, sits at IRIS granularity rather than in the Filosofi grid products.
stance_target: Hypothesis that education/diploma variables are unavailable at the 200m Filosofi carreaux level
scope_conditions: INSEE IRIS-level census-derived data products, annual vintages
quoted_support: The 'Diplome - Formation' (Diploma - Education) database provides data on the age of school-enrolled persons and education levels of non-enrolled persons.
